title: 星兽之憩

selectedMaster.selection: 首轮粗看：人物与单狮位于下中，狮侧卧闭眼且双手接鬃毛，大面积星空和含侧面的整块近景岩台清楚；未做统一复核。

generationRuns.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: opaque full-frame tarot card master for later holographic card production
Primary request: Create ONE original opaque full-frame 1024x1536 vertical Strength tarot master, theme 星兽之憩 / Rest of the Star Beast.
Input images: Image 1 is an identity, symbolic relationship, and painterly tarot-style reference only; create a new composition.
Subject: exactly ONE graceful dark-haired woman and exactly ONE full-sized lion-shaped celestial beast, still unmistakably a natural lion with a dark golden mane carrying sparse star patterns. The lion reclines side-on in the LOWER CENTER with eyes fully closed and mouth closed. The woman kneels beside it and uses BOTH visible hands to gently soothe and stroke the mane; palms meet the fur naturally without crossing into the head.
Scene/backdrop: vast deep-purple stellar plain beneath an immense open night sky with generous empty space, distant blue nebulae, and restrained gold-white stars.
Composition/framing: woman and lion occupy the lower central area; lion clearly side-on and resting. They stand and lie on ONE large near-view rock terrace with a visible thick side face extending fully to the bottom bleed, never a small floating pedestal. Sparse star leaves only near peripheral edges. Narrow mane-star-foil tarot border.
Style/medium: majestic detailed hand-painted fantasy tarot illustration, tactile natural lion anatomy with subtle celestial patterning, opaque RGB full scene.
Lighting/mood: quiet cosmic courage, tenderness, vast contemplative stillness.
Color palette: deep purple, gold white, midnight blue, natural skin, dark warm lion gold.
Constraints: exactly one woman and one lion; lion remains visibly leonine, resting with eyes and mouth closed; both hands visibly touch the mane; entire grounded rock terrace and contact shadows complete; large sky area remains open.
Avoid: extra people, extra lions or cubs, ghost animal, constellation outline replacing the body, roaring, open mouth, attack, pounce, circus, animal-taming performance, hand through head, floating mini-platform, cropped support, text, title, letters, numbers, watermark, logo.
generationRuns.conclusion: Selected opaque master after first-pass coarse visual check; no transparent layers, assembly, or formal review.
